action.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
echo "=== qgis healthcheck def ==="; sed -n '130,150p' docker-compose.dev.yml
echo "=== qgis root response ==="; docker exec qonnectra_qgis_server_dev wget -qO- "http://localhost:80/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities" 2>&1 | head -c 400
echo; echo "=== tilejson vs monaco bounds ==="; docker run --rm -v /workspace/deployment/tiles/germany.mbtiles:/g.mbtiles --entrypoint sh maptiler/tileserver-gl:v5.6.0 -c "command -v sqlite3 && sqlite3 /g.mbtiles 'select name,value from metadata where name in (\"bounds\",\"minzoom\",\"maxzoom\");'" 2>&1 | tail -5
